Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and packet. Quick answers: 
- We do PO for any contracts > $50k, so this will be PO.
- Procurement portal is the single source of truth; please upload the packet there (portal link below).
- Remit/ACH: we need the company legal name and EIN on the W-9 (your W-9 looks fine). Our AP team requires a banking stub that indicates the account type; we can accept the stub you provided as long as it has the bank routing and last 4 digits.

Marketplace: possibly later — procurement prefers direct PO for initial deployments.

Portal link: https://vendorportal.acmeanalytics.com/setup/rdw-1427

Procurement (cc’d) — can you confirm expected lead time for vendor setup and PO issuance once the packet is submitted?

Thanks,
Jordan
Head of Data Platform, Acme Analytics

Hi Marissa, Jordan —

Thanks for sending. A few notes from AP: 
1) Please upload the completed Vendor Setup Form (we received the packet but the vendor form PDF inside was blank). If you prefer, we can accept the attached vendor packet through the portal but need the form completed with the primary billing contact.
2) For W-9: PDF must be the filled/printed copy with EIN — the W-9 you included appears signed but missing the EIN field.
3) Banking: we require an ACH Authorization Form filled by your finance team (template is available in the portal). A banking stub is ok for initial verifications but the ACH form is required for faster payments.

Portal: https://vendorportal.acmeanalytics.com/setup/rdw-1427
DocuSign (if you prefer): https://www.docusign.com/en/frames/sign?envelopeId=abc123def456

Estimated vendor setup lead time: 5-7 business days after receiving a fully completed packet and verified W-9/ACH form. PO issuance generally follows once vendor status is active.

Regards,
